newsitem.title: UK: Norway's Gullfaks crude to load 21 cargoes in July.
newsitem.headline: Norway's Gullfaks crude to load 21 cargoes in July.

text.p: Norway's Gullfaks crude system is scheduled to load 21 standard 855,000 barrel cargoes in July, three fewer than last month, traders said.
The total volume in July is expected to be 17.95 million barrels, down 2.56 million barrels from June.

Traders said they were unaware of any maintenance planned for next month which might account for the shortfall but said it could be linked to recurring technical problems at Saga Petroleum's Vigdis field.
Production at the development was closed down on May 23 after a leak was detected in a gas compressor. Saga hope to resume production at the end of June, a spokesman told Reuters earlier this week.
Vigdis, which came on stream in January five months ahead of schedule, suffered an unscheduled shutdown on April 15 due to other problems with the compressor. The field restarted on May 16.
Vigdis was pumping about 50,000 barrels per day (bpd) before the latest incident, but peak output is planned to reach 75,000 bpd.
